cliSurface.discoveryReason: gemini --help lists no standalone agent-listing command. Official CLI docs specify /agents list as an interactive local command; project discovery was checked using the actual TUI before authentication.

startupProbe.environment: allow-listed PATH plus temporary HOME/XDG/TMP; no credential variables
terminalEvidence: Waiting for authentication... (Press Esc or Ctrl+C to cancel)
Do you trust the files in this folder?
Skipping project agents due to untrusted folder. To enable, ensure that the project root is trusted.
startupProbe.result: Startup reached the project trust prompt; before trust selection it skipped project agents. The CLI then remained at the no-input startup/authentication wait until the bounded alarm terminated it. No login, trust selection, slash command, model prompt, or model invocation was performed.

cliDiscoveryBarrier: Project discovery is verified by the real CLI positive and empty controls before auth. Invocation and runtime enforcement were not tested.

trustedStartupProbe.workspace: disposable project containing only the AOK-exported .gemini/agents/repository-explorer.md fixture
trustedStartupProbe.input: One key acknowledged/enabled the discovered agent only in the disposable HOME; no login or model prompt was sent.
trustedStartupProbe.result: TUI displayed New Agents Discovered with repository-explorer and its expected description before presenting authentication choices. Temporary acknowledgments/agents.json recorded the expected source SHA256.
trustedStartupProbe.autoUpdater: Enabled by default in this first trusted run; it initiated the global update detailed in autoUpdaterSideEffect.

autoUpdaterSideEffect.attribution: proven by npm debug log written under the isolated HOME of this run
autoUpdaterSideEffect.result: npm log recorded successful global install
autoUpdaterSideEffect.cleanup: Primary removed only the proven-created <GLOBAL_PREFIX>/bin/gemini symlink, version 0.64.0 package directory, and newly created empty @google namespace after attribution review. The temporary root/raw npm log was then removed by this worker; sanitized argv/path/version/timestamp are preserved in this evidence.

guardedCLIControls.credentials: No credential environment variables passed; no auth method selected.
guardedCLIControls.runtimeNpmGuard: NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX and npm_config_prefix plus npm cache, userconfig, globalconfig, and HOME were confined to the disposable probe root; npm config get prefix confirmed the temp prefix.

positive.discovery: TUI displayed New Agents Discovered with repository-explorer and expected description

emptyControl.discovery: No New Agents Discovered panel or custom agent identity; reached authentication choices with no method selected

guardedCLIControls.result: Positive project discovery matched the fixture identity/hash; the empty control showed no custom agent. Discovery occurred before auth in both cases.

sandbox.probe: A write test inside the root succeeded; final positive and empty TUI launches ran under this guard. No update banner appeared.

guardedCLIControls.exit: bounded 8-second no-input startup; harness alarm terminated process with exit 1 after the discovery/auth UI was captured
